value.rationale: The fixed-point-free involution family is the unique natural conjugacy class of perfect-matching permutations in even symmetric groups, not a contrived facet subset. Its first three simultaneous nonzero higher homology degrees are found at the smallest natural even alphabet cutoff eight and were not implied by fundamental group or generator counts. The result settles all four permissible cases through the first occurrence with complete exact ranks, providing a concrete structural benchmark for future work on ordered-word complexes.
